headline: Fort Lewis lose their first match at Northwest Nazarene
dek: Fort Lewis lost at Northwest Nazarene on Thursday, their first defeat after three wins and a draw. It was also the first match in which they have failed to score; they have thirteen goals for the season and have conceded four.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The gap between the top and the bottom of the chart is still wide: Colorado Mesa, Colorado School of Mines, Regis and Adams State have scored fewer goals together than UCCS have alone.

wire.line: Adams State have lost all three of their matches and are yet to score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: No match is a score gap today, but nine have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Regis's win over Seattle Pacific is their second, and they have scored four goals and conceded two across two wins, a draw and a defeat.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Westminster's win over Western Washington is their second, and with three draws beside it they are still unbeaten.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado School of Mines have lost four and drawn one after the defeat to UT Tyler, and have scored two goals while conceding ten.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Zach Jennings has made eighteen saves for Regis and been beaten twice.

last_match.line: Fort Lewis's first defeat, and the first match they have not scored in; Northwest Nazarene had already drawn at Westminster and at MSU Denver.

next_match.line: UCCS are unbeaten and have scored in every match; the draw with Midwestern State is the only points they have dropped.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
